method: AutoDock Vina v1.2.3 + prolif interaction analysis

docking_results.improvement_note: 5.47 kcal/mol improvement from Vina scoring function. Previously claimed Coulomb-law-based ΔΔG of -7.3 kcal/mol was based on incorrect LYS8 salt bridge assumption (actual distance to LYS8 is 15.4 Å).

salt_bridge.note: Previously claimed LYS8 was WRONG (15.4 Å). Actual COOH points to Box B region.

p4ward_results.note: Geometric screen from P4ward MegaDock output confirmed.

verdict: H2 computationally supported. A1_4COOH shows -11.22 kcal/mol Vina score vs -5.75 for parent ICM. COOH provides solvent-exposed exit vector (4.5 Å from protein surface) and forms H-bonds with LYS85 in Box B.
